entities.summary: Kent Carlsson is a former tennis player from Sweden. A seasoned claycourter, he won all nine of his ATP tour singles titles on the surface, including the 1988 Hamburg Masters. Carlsson achieved a career-high singles ranking of World No. 6 in September 1988. Kent Carlsson was a athletes & competitors from Eskilstuna (b. 1968-01-03, Eskilstuna).
